title: Add staged RBACv2 rollout tooling and KMS escrow validation
author: Evan Brooks
description: Motivation: Customers running in regulated regions requested a safer path to migrate to RBAC v2 while ensuring KMS key usage is provably region-scoped and escrowed for audit. This PR introduces a small, audit-focused middleware (residency-assertor) plus operator tooling to stage RBACv2 policy rollouts and validate KMS escrow assertions. The change implements: 1) residency-assertor service that intercepts token-bearing operator requests, validates tenant region claims against a residency registry, attaches a signed KMS-escrow assertion (HSM-backed signing hook) when a delegated CMK is used, and emits compacted audit events with deterministic entropy reduction; 2) rbacv2 rollout CLI and migration hooks that can apply policies in staged cohorts (cohort definitions, canary percentage, rollback thresholds) and produce a dry-run plan; 3) migration tests and a policy-simulator that checks for unintended privilege expansions across service boundaries; 4) Helm chart and Kubernetes manifests to run residency-assertor in Dedicated and Private installs with optional HSM/KMS integration; 5) observability additions: per-tenant KMS-usage metrics, escrow assertion counters, and a small audit-compaction worker to reduce log retention costs while retaining verification signatures. Backwards compatibility: residency-assertor can operate in passive mode where it only observes and logs mismatches; RBAC CLI has a --dry-run flag and default cohort 0 to avoid accidental rollouts. Security: HSM hook is pluggable; default uses existing KMS path with an extra signature envelope that includes key-region and signer-thumbprint. Migration notes: operators should run policy-simulator and then stage cohorts at 1%, 10%, 50% before full rollout. Checklist: - [x] residency-assertor service and API - [x] staged-rollout CLI and policy-simulator - [x] Helm chart + k8s manifests - [x] unit + integration tests for simulator and escrow signer - [x] docs: rollout guide and runbook - [x] performance tests to validate <5% p95 latency regressions in proxy path Related: ENG-4523 (policy rollout), ENG-4601 (kms escrow audit).
commits_summary: 4 commits: 1) Add residency-assertor service scaffold and API, 2) Implement KMS escrow signer integration and audit envelope, 3) RBACv2 staged-rollout CLI and policy-simulator, 4) Helm chart, tests, and docs. Each commit focused and tested; third commit includes migration simulator and sample cohort configs.
